cell_type.evidence: Trophoblastic cell lines are widely used in in vitro studies of placental function as a surrogate for primary trophoblasts.

Our data indicate that BeWo cells express an epithelial proteome more characteristic of villous trophoblasts, whereas HTR8/SVneo cells embrace a mesenchymal phenotype, more characteristic of extravillous trophoblasts.
